title: Change Impact Payload
description: Structured payload analyzing the effect of an upstream document (PLAN.md / SPEC.md / a Ticket) change, per Harness main document, section 10 (Change Impact Handling).

change_type.description: NON_BEHAVIORAL changes (wording, formatting, non-behavioral clarification) must not auto-invalidate downstream Tickets.

affected_tickets.description: Every V1 Ticket that traces to the changed item, even if the action is NONE.

action.description: INVALIDATED only applies to a Ticket that was already COMPLETE and whose completion condition no longer holds.
